summary.headline: Enemy Soldiers and Astrological Victory
summary.text: Astrological interrogation concerning an enemy’s soldiers petitioning for substance, their hoped-for gifts and obedience, and the enemy’s future opposition. The interpretation uses the Moon in Capricorn, Mars in Cancer, Mercury joined to Saturn by opposition, house lords, reception, cadency, and prospects of victory and kingdom.
